title: Proposed links for one level (metadata-matcher)
description: One entry per box of the matcher brief: the metadata to link to it, or why none is linked; and, before the final round, more words to search the org for.

id.description: The box's id in the brief.

decision.description: links: link the components listed. no-org-support: the step happens outside Salesforce (a phone call, a meeting, a decision in someone's head). nothing-found: the step needs the org, but no candidate does it.

why.description: How the component serves the step, in one sentence; for a picklist field, the values the step sets.

reason.description: no-org-support or nothing-found: why, in one sentence.

gapNote.description: nothing-found: the sticky note's text, what the org lacks for this step.

moreTerms.description: Before the final round only: words to search for boxes whose candidates do not settle them (a flow's likely name, a field's label).
